documents.title: Upgrade Guide to Tailwind CSS v4 – Tailwind Documentation
documents.description: Comprehensive guide for migrating your frontend styles to Tailwind CSS v4 featuring the new high-speed Rust-powered engine and CSS-first configuration.
documents.mainText:
Upgrading to Tailwind CSS v4

Tailwind CSS v4 is a ground-up rewrite of the framework, designed for speed and built using a new unified CSS-first configuration model.

New Engine Architecture

Built with Lightning CSS, Tailwind v4 compiles stylesheets up to 10x faster with a fraction of memory usage.

documents.title: torvalds/linux: Linux kernel source tree – GitHub
documents.description: Linux kernel source tree maintained by Linus Torvalds. The open source monolithic operating system kernel powering cloud servers, supercomputers, and mobile devices.
documents.mainText:
Linux Kernel Source Repository

Linux is a free software, open-source Unix-like operating system kernel created by Linus Torvalds in 1991. The codebase is primarily written in C with portions in Rust and assembly.

Subsystems & Architecture

Includes memory management, process scheduling, virtual file system (VFS), networking stack, device drivers, and namespace isolation for Docker and Linux containers.

documents.title: Architecture of SQLite – In-Process SQL Database Engine
documents.description: Technical architecture and internal subsystems of SQLite: tokenizer, parser, code generator, virtual machine (VDBE), B-Tree, pager, and OS interface.
documents.mainText:
The Architecture of SQLite

SQLite is structured into three main subsystems: the compiler subsystem (SQL frontend), the execution engine (virtual database engine VDBE), and the storage backend (B-tree and pager).

Virtual Database Engine (VDBE)

The VDBE is a register-based virtual machine that executes bytecode instructions produced by the SQL parser and code generator to read or write database records.

documents.title: What is Kubernetes? | Kubernetes Cloud Infrastructure
documents.description: Kubernetes is an open-source container orchestration system for automating software deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications.
documents.mainText:
Introduction to Kubernetes Container Orchestration

Kubernetes provides a framework to run distributed systems resiliently. It takes care of scaling and failover for your application, provides deployment patterns, and manages cluster hardware resources.

documents.title: Docker Overview | Containerization Platform Architecture
documents.description: Docker is an open platform for developing, shipping, and running applications using OS-level containerization for predictable environments.
documents.mainText:
Docker Platform Overview

Docker provides the ability to package and run an application in a loosely isolated environment called a container. The isolation and security allow you to run many containers simultaneously on a given host.

documents.title: The Double Ratchet Algorithm – Signal Cryptographic Protocol
documents.description: Cryptographic specification of the Double Ratchet Algorithm: providing end-to-end encryption with forward secrecy and break-in recovery for messaging protocols.
documents.mainText:
The Double Ratchet Cryptographic Algorithm

The Double Ratchet algorithm is used by two parties to exchange encrypted messages based on a shared secret key. The parties derive new keys for every message so that earlier keys cannot be calculated from later ones (forward secrecy).
